pr_body:
Solves the issue raised in #35529 and adds calibration to the ADCs on request.

Fixes https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/issues/35529

issue_context.title: STM32: STM32H7 ADC calibration must be performed on startup
issue_context.body:
**Is your enhancement proposal related to a problem? Please describe.**
During working with the STM32H743, we found that the ADC's are not acting linear (missing codes) under current Zephyr version.
This seems to be due to the fact that no calibration of the ADC is performed. The calibration is necessary according to [AN5354](https://www.st.com/resource/en/application_note/dm00628458-getting-started-with-the-stm32h7-series-mcu-16bit-adc-stmicroelectronics.pdf) section 2.5.

**Describe the solution you'd like**
Have the API automatically perform an offset calibration in [adc_stm32_init](https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/blob/58d3760533a6b1f44f7f871fddfbe63f009338a0/drivers/adc/adc_stm32.c#L611) and load the linearity factory defaults from FLASH for the STM32H7xx.

**Describe alternatives you've considered**
Currently manually doing this with HAL, but should be added to Zephyr.

**Additional context**
I will try to submit a pull request during next week for this.

Additionally have I seen correctly that setting the calibration bit in the [adc_sequence](https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/blob/eb949d01d3afe2d508e0c66d4e5c719b4ffbca4a/include/drivers/adc.h#L262) does nothing for the STM32? It should at least call the `adc_stm32_calib` function (and perform offset calibration). If someone can confirm this, I can probably incorporate this into the pull request.

review_comments:
What about  the following ?
```
      LL_ADC_StartCalibration(adc,
#if defined(CONFIG_SOC_SERIES_STM32H7X)
                                           LL_ADC_CALIB_OFFSET
#endif
#if defined(CONFIG_SOC_SERIES_STM32F0X) || \
     defined(CONFIG_SOC_SERIES_STM32G0X) || \
     defined(CONFIG_SOC_SERIES_STM32H7X) || \
     defined(CONFIG_SOC_SERIES_STM32L0X) || \
     defined(CONFIG_SOC_SERIES_STM32WLX)
                                           LL_ADC_SINGLE_ENDED
#endif
                                           );
```

Personally I don't find this easier to read and maintain, I prefer the previous implementation
By the way it seems it is a source of mistake :smile: :
* "," is misplaced between "adc" and  LL_ADC_CALIB_OFFSET, it should be in the #if
* there is a missing "," between both LL_xxx parameters)
I agree with @ABOSTM. I find it easier to debug seeing the full call instead of having to piece it together from some ifdefs.
